title: After Macmillan's Minotaur Books signed a two-book, $2M deal with author Jerry Falade, his agency, Europa Content, withdrew support over concerns he used AI (Melissa Korn/Wall Street Journal)
description: Melissa Korn / Wall Street Journal : After Macmillan's Minotaur Books signed a two-book, $2M deal with author Jerry Falade, his agency, Europa Content, withdrew support over concerns he used AI — Fourteen publishers fought over Jerry Falade's debut novel. After it sold, his agent pulled support over AI concerns.

title: Renting A Bike Or Car In Goa? AI Traffic Cameras Go Live From August 1
description: Goa's AI-based traffic enforcement went live August 1 at 26 junctions after a two-month grace period, following an 80% compliance improvement since June. Tourists renting vehicles are especially advised to comply with rules.
